answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the timber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The copper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dune is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
